name: Kumotori Hut
description: An organic, serene and technical hospitality theme for a mountain hut at a 2,017 m saddle. Alpine moss pages, lichen panels, pine ink text and one muted pine accent; Faustina for display over Readex Pro. The hero and decorations are 2.5D isometric raster illustrations (the saddle and its trails, the hut, a cutaway bunk room, the ridge). A slim bar docked at the bottom of the screen (H7) holds the wordmark, the menu and a Reception open / Closed chip worked out on the server from the site's timezone, like a trail signpost. The home page is map first (L10): the isometric trail map beside the title with a numbered legend for the hut, the three routes and the water points, then this season's dates, reception hours and weather note, the synced rates card, the routes and the journal. The footer (F12) is the hut's summit stamp, the address card and a vertical altitude line from trailhead to saddle. Routes, Stay & booking, Season, Journal, Newsletter and Contact. Season dates, reception hours, weather note, address and phone are edited once in Appearance > Hut details; the rates and beds card is one synced pattern. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: Codes: none (H7 + F12 + L10 as planned; combination unused: Yuge Sento is H7/F6/L7, Mimi Veterinary H9/F7/L10). Neighbours: Tsuba Millinery (H12/F3/L14, pink light) and Aoi Hanga (H4/F2/L3, indigo light) share no code or palette family. Palette as planned (alpine moss #DDE2DA, lichen #C2CBBE, pine ink #1F2A22, muted pine #5C7563) plus deep pine #34503D for links and buttons (6.8:1 on moss / 5.3:1 on lichen), quiet moss #48554B for secondary text (6.0:1 / 4.7:1) and hut paper #ECEFE9 for cards; muted pine #5C7563 (3.8:1) is for numerals, rules, the legend rings and large type only. Pine ink is 11.3:1 on moss. Fonts verified against google/fonts OFL.txt: Faustina is OFL-1.1 without a Reserved Font Name; Readex Pro is OFL-1.1 with the RFN "RevReading Lexend", so both ship as the unmodified upstream variable TTFs (files renamed only). Industry mountain-hut is new. Built from the Yuge Sento structure (H7 bottom bar with the server-side open chip, now Reception open / Closed), with a new L10 map-first home and a new F12 summit stamp + vertical altitude footer. Visual style 2.5D isometric: 4 raster WebP illustrations (trail map of the saddle, hut, cutaway bunk room, ridge routes) from Grok Build image_gen via scripts/grok-image.sh, checked by eye for text and logos. Synced: Hut details (season dates, reception hours, weather note, address, phone) and the rates and beds card.

summary.en: A calm site for a mountain hut: an isometric trail map opens the page with the hut, three routes and water points, then season, weather and stay.

summary.fr: Un site calme pour un refuge de montagne : une carte isométrique des sentiers ouvre la page avec le refuge, trois itinéraires et les points d’eau, puis la saison, la météo et le séjour.
